answer: Proposed flood-data payouts require one key per licensed gauge on a ledge above a delta floodplain. In a surprise shared window, independent receivers triangulate each signed radio reply to a surveyed grid vertex; validators reject duplicate site IDs. A farm can share its model and lease equipment, but k paid keys need k distinct licensed sites and live gauges for 60 days; financing cannot place two gauges at one registered vertex. Missing proof gets zero pay; a forged signed location slashes its site bond. Surveyors and validators must enforce this, not MinePoA today.
